# Agrishield India

> Agrishield (operated by Srii Veerabhadreshwara Krushi Kendra) is an advanced agricultural e-commerce and crop protection advisory platform in India. We provide organic and certified crop protection solutions, wild animal deterrents, repellents, seeds, and fertilizers directly to farmers.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://agrishield.in/): Official homepage featuring our top organic crop protection products, wild boar repellents, and solar alarm strobes.
- [Shop](https://agrishield.in/shop): Full product catalog of agricultural repellents, strobes, and organic farm defense systems.
- [About Us](https://agrishield.in/about): Learn about Srii Veerabhadreshwara Krushi Kendra and our mission to protect Indian crops.
- [Contact](https://agrishield.in/contact): Get direct agricultural advisory and customer support from our expert agronomists.
- [Blog & Advisory](https://agrishield.in/blog): Farming guides, pest control techniques, and organic crop defense articles.

## Featured Crop Protection Products

- [Wild Boar Repellent](https://agrishield.in/product/1): Certified organic repellent granules and sprays to keep wild boars out of crops.
- [Organic Snake Repellent Powder](https://agrishield.in/product/2): Natural boundary line defense against venomous and non-venomous snakes.
- [Solar Alarm Strobe Light](https://agrishield.in/product/3): Solar-powered night animal deterrent with siren and flashing strobe.
- [Monkey Repellent Nuts](https://agrishield.in/product/4): Non-toxic taste aversion repellent to protect fruit orchards and plantations.
